name: Tapolca (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the town arms of Tapolca (a red shield with a white castle wall, with a helm, a red lion crest and red and yellow mantling) above the name TAPOLCA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tapolca arms with helm, crest and mantling
